recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. If maintainers want the embedded UML tooltip refreshed, regenerate the affected resource notes/diagram artifacts from the authoritative Meta.source definition rather than manually editing generated-looking SVG content.
issue_request: FHIR-49878 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 clarification asking to change Meta.source from identifying the source system/FHIR server to identifying the data source, including another server/document/message/database and portions of a structure.
initial_application: Git commit b351c4c2f5b5caf51b72bfc1ec1a480d588f6832, 'FHIR-49878 Clarify meta.source scope', changed source/datatypes/meta.xml and source/resource/resource-notes.xml. Current blame on source/datatypes/meta.xml:626 points to that commit.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes for 2025-02-24 show FHIR-49878 was created from the FHIR-47701 elementSource discussion because the group concluded that meta.source also needed clarification. source/fhir.ini keeps Meta and Resource in build scope. The resource notes narrative does not contradict the clarified definition, and the only residual narrower wording found is in generated-looking embedded UML tooltip text.
reconciliation: No source edit was made because source/datatypes/meta.xml already contains the requested definition, including the data-source wording and the portions-of-structure sentence. Hand-editing generated-looking diagram tooltip content would not be a necessary source correction.

related_jiras.note: The elementSource extension request triggered the FHIR-I discussion that created FHIR-49878, but it concerns a separate extension decision and was not decided here.
